name: io.github.dungxbuif/couchloom
description: Multi-vault CouchDB RAG and safe note access for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the validated multi-vault JSON file

environmentVariables.name: VAULTS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Inline multi-vault JSON; mutually exclusive with VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for the pgvector index

environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Server base URL used by authentication

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Disable write_note and edit_note when true
